scope: four seen seasons; measurement only; no simulator, card fit or engine changes; stop after T2b

acquisition.requests: global and each of30 franchises full-season; target franchise all/catch/pull for each of82 game dates; retries2 timeout20s concurrency4; empty valid tables are recorded not silently rejected
acquisition.freeze: raw API responses SHA before analysis; no new seasons
acquisition.fallback: if tracking unavailable use PBP assisted makes and explicit pullup labels, never call unassisted/ordinary jumpers catch-and-shoot

organizer.primary: largest AST/min among franchise players MIN>=500 and MPG>=20, tie total AST then numeric ID; all individual season counts; descriptive end-season cutoff
organizer.anchors: current-season organizer plus previous-season same rule; report separately; prior-year anchor can have zero target-season minutes, do not replace or impute ON
organizer.strictOnOff: only strict games with organizer observed on court, separate ON/OFF at action index, shooter must be different; no-season played games excluded from this contrast
organizer.gameAvailability: additional official C/S and pullup by-date aggregates compare organizer played vs DNP; explicitly not on-court contrast
organizer.rolePlayers: target rotation MIN>=500 union top10; role subgroup official individual AST_PCT<20% and USG_PCT<25%, excluding organizers

pbp.join: shot action i must satisfy stint.startIndex<=i<endIndex and matching period; shooter on offensive five required
pbp.shots: isFieldGoal and actionType2pt/3pt; zones three/mid/paint per original code; original event descriptors preserved
pbp.pullupProxy: explicit descriptor/subType/description pullup or pull-up; not complete tracking definition
pbp.assisted: assistPersonId present only on made shot; denominator FGM, never FGA; missing-assist field not a label for missed-shot creation
pbp.catchProxy: none; exact on-court C/S and complete pullup rates unavailable without per-shot tracking labels
pbp.standardization: ON-OFF FG and assisted-make share compare within player and zone (paint/mid/three); pooled weight=min(ON FGA,OFF FGA), minimum50 FGA per state per player; zone-specific strata minimum20FGA per state; game-only possession outcomes remain descriptive

portability.adjacent: both seasons MIN>=500, dominant franchise>=60%; same vs moved; each tracking category FGA>=100 for FG,3PA>=75 for3FG; distribution requires total FGA>=200
portability.withinSeason: old T2 chronology and official trade eligibility; each franchise MIN>=300; categoryFGA>=50,3PA>=40; do not impute missing team-filtered tracking
portability.uncertainty: 20000 paired player+franchise cluster bootstrap, equal transitions re-centered inside replicate; caseON/OFF bootstrap whole games20000; no simulation seed sampling in non-simulated measurements

cardAudit.prior: exact A2 L2 effective prior-season card artifact if stored; otherwise immutable source recipe before target output and label provenance
cardAudit.current: exact T0 same-season card bundle; report unprojected attrs and effective engine shooting calibration separately
cardAudit.categoryRates: official catch/pull FG,3FG,attempt share; these are observed rates, not separate fields currently present in cards
cardAudit.decomposition: prior-to-current category rate changes weighted by target category attempts, held-out prior absence reported; no causal PPG attribution and no claim card gap fully explains engine net gap
cardAudit.hypothesis: support concentration only if catch component has larger absolute target-weighted scoring-rate change than pull and other; role subgroup must agree; game-level/within-court organizer direction also reported, inconclusive if unsupported

alternatives.age: season bio official AGE; no age curve
alternatives.injury: official NBA/team public reports for organizers and target rotation where verifiable; label unverified for others; GP/minutes are exposure not medical diagnoses

t2Erratum.reason: source schema confirms stint.opponent.dreb is defending-team DREB; previous T2-supplement swapped to other team incorrectly
t2Erratum.action: preserve old outputs; separate erratum restores own defending-team counts and reports affected strict-bin DREB only; cached full-season box/sim DREB and prior main conclusions unaffected
t2Erratum.notAllowed: no silent overwrite of old report or fit
